decisions.reason: Audio and web conferencing is a peripheral, low-investment add-on outside the software-defined infrastructure direction and faces strong competition from cloud collaboration tools, but its running cost is low and pandemic-era demand gives a temporary reason to keep it in the broad portfolio.
The metro data centre network rests on sunk owned-fibre investment, has publicly reported adoption, and is central to the announced data centre and cloud direction, so commitment remains strong.
Optical spectrum connectivity uses existing fibre assets, was showcased on its own page, and fits the high-bandwidth strategy, which keeps both commitment and justification for it high.
The number ordering portal supports the announced real-time provisioning direction and costs little to maintain, so there is no reason to withdraw it.

Carrier pre-selection is a declining legacy telephony service with little strategic centrality and low visible commitment, and a direct voice service (Product F) has already been dropped, so its resources are better moved to the software-defined core.
